notes: Physical serial/control connectors (Cresnet, COM1-3, IR/Serial 1-8, Relay 1-8, I/O 1-8) are all detachable 3.5mm pitch terminal blocks (3-, 4-, 5-, 8-, or 9-pin depending on function), not XLR-style euroblocks in the strict sense — mapped to 'euroblock' as the closest connector id in the allowed list since no generic screw-terminal id exists. COM1 is a combo RS-232/422/485 port (primary connector set to rs232 with rs422/rs485 in accepts); COM2 and COM3 are RS-232 only. IR/Serial Output ports (8 total, on two terminal blocks) are IR output with 1-way serial TTL/RS-232 capability, mapped to connector 'ir'. Relay outputs (8 total, on two terminal blocks) are dry-contact relays with no matching connector id in the list; mapped to 'euroblock' as closest physical match (not a signal/power jack). Versiport I/O (8 ports, one terminal block) are digital/analog GPIO, also mapped to 'euroblock' as closest physical match. Ethernet is Gigabit-capable (100/1000Base-TX auto-negotiating). USB ports are USB 2.0 (Type-A rear host for storage, Type-B front for console/computer setup). Power input is 24VDC via 2.1x5.5mm DC barrel jack, powered by an included external PW-2420RU power pack (100-240VAC input, 2.5A/24VDC output) — device itself has no AC inlet. An SD/SDHC card slot (up to 32GB) exists for storage but is omitted as it is not a signal/power I/O port. Not rack-mountable in the traditional 19" sense without included rack ears, but is a 1RU-height chassis; rackUnits set to 1 accordingly (also usable as a desktop/shelf unit with adhesive feet). Sources: docs.crestron.com CP4/CP4N specifications page and crestron.com official product catalog page, both from Crestron; cross-checked and in full agreement on connector counts and types.

ports.name: Cresnet
ports.note: 4-pin 3.5mm detachable terminal block; Cresnet master port, provides 15W bus power when power pack connected

ports.name: USB (rear, Type A)
ports.note: Host port for USB storage devices

ports.name: USB (front, Type B)
ports.note: Device port for computer console setup

ports.name: COM 1
ports.note: 5-pin 3.5mm terminal block; software-selectable RS-232/422/485, up to 115.2k baud

ports.name: IR/Serial Output 1-8
ports.note: Two 8-pin 3.5mm terminal blocks; IR up to 1.2MHz or 1-way serial TTL/RS-232 (0-5V) up to 115.2k baud

ports.name: Relay Output 1-8
ports.note: Two 8-pin 3.5mm terminal blocks; 8 normally-open isolated relays, rated 1A, 30VAC/VDC. Closest connector id used; physically a dry-contact relay terminal block, not a signal jack

ports.name: I/O 1-8 (Versiport)
ports.note: One 9-pin 3.5mm terminal block; configurable digital I/O (0-24VDC in, 250mA out) or analog input (0-10VDC). Closest connector id used; physically a GPIO terminal block

ports.name: 24V DC Power Input
ports.note: 2.1 x 5.5mm DC jack, 24VDC; powered by included external PW-2420RU power pack (100-240VAC in, 2.5A/24VDC out)
